paper_title: ADMX SLIC: Results from a Superconducting LC Circuit Investigating Cold Axions
notes: ADMX SLIC is a haloscope experiment using a superconducting LC circuit to search for low-mass axions. The paper presents exclusion limits on axion-photon coupling g_agamma in three frequency/mass ranges at different magnetic field strengths (4.5 T, 5.0 T, 7.0 T). The abstract states 'Exclusion results from the search data, for coupling below 10^-12 GeV^-1 are presented.' Figure 4 shows the exclusion limits, with the blue lines representing the actual measured limits (RFI-limited) and orange lines showing estimated limits if RFI were eliminated. The data points are extracted from the three mass ranges covered: (1) 1.7498–1.7519 × 10^-7 eV at 4.5 T, (2) 1.7734–1.7738 × 10^-7 eV at 5.0 T, and (3) 1.8007–1.8015 × 10^-7 eV at 7.0 T. Approximate coupling limits are read from Figure 4a (combined limits). The standard local DM density of 0.3 GeV/cm³ is assumed for haloscope experiments. Extraction confidence is moderate (0.75) because while the coupling type and experiment are clear, the exact numerical limits from Figure 4 are approximate readings from the plot rather than tabulated values. | selector: text (sole candidate)
